title: 4 rules of the sigma engineer
description: Four engineering principles, delivered with unreasonable seriousness.

scenes.narration: Rule one. The sigma engineer reads the docs. While they scroll tutorials, he ships.
scenes.headline: Rule 1: Read the docs

scenes.narration: Rule two. Never optimize what you have not measured. Profile first. Then touch the code.
scenes.headline: Rule 2: Measure first

scenes.narration: Rule three. No Friday deploys. Weekends are for silence, not rollbacks.
scenes.headline: Rule 3: No Friday deploys

scenes.narration: Rule four. Write the test before the excuse.
scenes.headline: Rule 4: Test before excuse

scenes.narration: Which rule do you break the most? Be honest. Comment it.
scenes.headline: Which rule do you break?
